story.headline: From Friends to Founders
story.intro: Beirut Apparel began in May 2019 — two best friends, one city, and the simple idea that what you wear should carry the spirit of where you come from. Seven years later, Lynn & Nour have built a label rooted in Beirut and inspired by the everyday.
story.body: A city that has seen it all, Beirut taught us to keep going through every high and low. Our pieces carry that same spirit — resilience, beauty, and effortless style. From our first linen sets to sun-washed summer edits, everything is designed with the belief that fashion should feel like you.
